parsed.evidence_sentence: Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person or Medicare-approved telehealth visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1)-(4) above are met.
parsed.wording_differences:

Revised: 'Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person or Medicare-approved telehealth visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1)-(4) above are met.'
Differences: none.
parsed.explanation: The sentence in the revised policy is verbatim to the original sentence from which the rule was derived. There are no wording differences, qualifiers, or scope changes. Therefore, the requirement survives with the same meaning and does not change what claims qualify.
